method: Actual Vue workshop rendered in an isolated browser session. Workspace, navigation, editor and document fixtures are composed in memory and delivered through the workshop transport. Conversation title and events are supplied separately through the existing ChatView conversation prop by setting ChatView.props.conversation.default before mounting. No DOM text replacement, UI overlays or image compositing.
reproduction: Run npm ci in client, install cwebp and Chrome, then run node website/capture-workshop.mjs from the repository root. The script starts and closes its own ephemeral-port Vite server; it never attaches to an existing server.
limitations: Browser geometry is not native-device qualification. Mobile uses the workshop iOS profile with synthetic safe areas and no keyboard.
Responses and document pages are authored synthetic examples; no AI requests, accounts, personal workspaces or external services are used.
Provider and plugin screens retain the workshop’s existing options and fixtures; they do not establish shipped integrations or real account access.
Rasterization can vary between runs and across hosts and browsers; hashes describe these captured files, not guaranteed pixel equality.
